      <div data-fluid-engine="true"><style></style><div class="fluid-engine fe-685552d4059edb41eb2682f1"><div class="fe-block fe-block-5c8edcb8da27218fda55"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="5c8edcb8da27218fda55" id="block-5c8edcb8da27218fda55"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Almond Tree Studio</strong></h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><em>Private • Shaded • Treetop Atmosphere</em></strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Tucked at the far end of the top floor, the Almond Tree Studio is one of the most private retreats at Camp Bay Lodge. Surrounded by garden views, mangrove canopy, and a unique touch of nature, this studio offers a calm and secluded space while still being just a short walk from the beach.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Inside, the studio features a queen bed, a fully equipped kitchenette, and a private bathroom finished with handcrafted Honduran cement tiles. Large doors and louvered windows on three sides allow the steady trade winds to flow through the space, keeping it naturally comfortable day and night.<br> Air conditioning is also available for added comfort.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">One of the studio’s defining features is its expansive shaded deck, built around a towering Traveler’s Palm that rises directly through the space. This creates a peaceful, treetop feel — a perfect spot to lounge in your hammock, read, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. From here, you can look out over the gardens, grounds, and mangrove forest, with a small peek of the Caribbean Sea just beyond.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Spacious, quiet, and filled with gentle natural light, the Almond Tree Studio is ideal for couples, solo travelers, or small families who value privacy and a serene connection to nature.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">A calm, elevated escape — perfect for unwinding after a day exploring Roatán’s quiet East End.</p></div>
